summary.text: Mark Yuengling is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windsor-2 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican VL Coffin.
According to Ballotpedia, he has worked as an artist and in union-management negotiations.

paragraphs.text: Mark Yuengling was born in Port Jervis, New York, and graduated from Port Jervis High School, according to Ballotpedia.
He attended the State University of New York, Fredonia, and his career experience includes working as an artist and in union-management negotiations.
Yuengling advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary with 98.5 percent of the vote.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is seeking office to return the Legislature to the functionality he observed nearly two decades ago, and named lowering reliance on property taxes by shifting toward income taxation as a top priority.
He listed education, universal primary care, housing and transportation as the areas of public policy he is passionate about, and said policy should come before party.
